messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points in the unit square that maximizes the minimum triangle area among all 286 triangles is the 'truncated triangular grid': the four corners of the square, the four midpoints of the sides, the center, and four points at the midpoints of the segments connecting the center to each corner. This symmetric arrangement, related to the optimal 13-point hexagonal packing, achieves a minimum triangle area of 1/32, and no configuration of 13 points in the unit square can guarantee a larger minimum triangle area."}
